findings.title: ClaudeBleed — Claude Chrome Extension Multi-App Takeover (LayerX, Partial Patch)
findings.affected_technology: Anthropic Claude for Chrome browser extension
findings.summary: Claude for Chrome extension trusts page origin rather than execution context, letting any installed extension drive the Claude AI agent to exfiltrate from Gmail, GitHub, Drive, Notion; Anthropic's partial fix is bypassable via privileged mode.

findings.title: Polish ABW Reports ICS Breaches at Five Water-Treatment Plants — APT28 / APT29 / UNC1151
findings.summary: Poland's Internal Security Agency confirmed Russian APT28/APT29 and Belarusian UNC1151 modified equipment operational parameters at five water-treatment facilities in 2024-2025 via weak passwords and direct internet exposure.

findings.title: OpenClaw 9-CVE Batch — 3 Critical (Auth Bypass, LPE, CDP Exposure) — VulnCheck
findings.summary: VulnCheck disclosed 9 OpenClaw vulnerabilities including critical noVNC auth bypass, async-event privilege escalation, and CDP-relay exposure that chain together for full sandbox escape; patched in 2026.4.10/2026.4.14.

findings.title: Open WebUI CVE-2026-44551 — LDAP Empty-Password Authentication Bypass
findings.summary: Open WebUI fails to validate non-empty password before LDAP bind, so a single POST with valid username and empty password yields a full session token against default OpenLDAP / AD configurations; fixed in 0.9.0.

findings.title: FastGPT CVE-2026-42302 — Agent-Sandbox Unauth RCE on Port 8080
findings.summary: FastGPT agent-sandbox component disables authentication by default on port 8080, enabling unauthenticated remote code execution; second unauth-impact FastGPT CVE in 30 days.

findings.title: Braintrust SaaS-Token Theft — Third AI-Vendor-as-Credential-Warehouse Incident in 14 Days
findings.summary: Attacker accessed Braintrust's internal AWS account and harvested customer-stored org-level AI provider keys (OpenAI/Anthropic) with confirmed customer impact; third SaaS-token-theft incident in 14 days after Anodot and DigiCert.

findings.title: Postiz-app CVE-2026-42298 — Workflow Docker-Build RCE via PR (CVSS 10.0)
findings.summary: Postiz CI workflow trusts PR-submitted Dockerfile during build, allowing unauthenticated external contributors to execute arbitrary code in the build runner with workflow secrets in scope.

findings.title: PamDOORa — Linux PAM-Based SSH Backdoor Sold on Russian Forum
findings.summary: Flare.io published analysis of PamDOORa, a PAM-based post-exploitation backdoor advertised by 'darkworm' on Rehub forum since March 2026 with credential harvesting, magic-password SSH, log tampering, and anti-debugging.

findings.title: 5 Malicious NuGet Packages Impersonate Chinese UI Libraries — Socket.dev
findings.summary: Socket.dev disclosed five malicious NuGet packages posing as Chinese .NET UI libraries that deploy credential stealer plus cryptocurrency-wallet-theft tooling; first significant 2026 NuGet supply-chain wave after npm/PyPI/RubyGems/Go.

findings.title: electerm CVE-2026-43940 / 43944 — Path Traversal Arbitrary Code Execution
findings.affected_technology: electerm cross-platform Electron-based SSH/SFTP/Telnet terminal client
findings.summary: Two vulnerabilities in electerm allow arbitrary code execution via path traversal and via dangerous link/CLI handling; widely used by sysadmins/devs across Windows, Mac, Linux.

findings.title: MailEnable CVE-2026-44400 — WebAdmin Authorization Bypass
findings.summary: Authorization bypass in MailEnable WebAdmin interface grants administrative access to mail-server management plane without proper authentication; full mail-flow / mailbox compromise from a single bypass.

findings.title: Ivanti EPMM CVE-2026-6973 — Vendor Patches Released, KEV Deadline 2026-05-10
findings.summary: Ivanti shipped 12.6.1.1/12.7.0.1/12.8.0.1 patches on 2026-05-08; CISA KEV-added the same day with 4-day federal deadline 2026-05-10; Shadowserver tracks 800+ exposed appliances and chain depends on prior CVE-2026-1281+1340 credential theft.

findings.title: Trellix Source-Code Breach — RansomHouse Claims Responsibility
findings.affected_technology: Trellix XDR / EDR vendor source-code repository
findings.summary: RansomHouse publicly claimed the Trellix breach 2026-05-08 with stated intrusion date 2026-04-17 (3+ weeks before disclosure); screenshots indicate access to appliance management system; Fortune 100 supply-chain integrity concern.

findings.title: Dirty Frag Linux LPE — CVEs Assigned (CVE-2026-43284, CVE-2026-43500)
findings.affected_technology: Linux kernel (Ubuntu, RHEL, CentOS Stream, AlmaLinux, openSUSE Tumbleweed, Fedora)
findings.summary: Wiz published Dirty Frag analysis with formal CVE assignments for the xfrm/ESP and RxRPC page-cache writes that chain for root via single command; Cloudflare published mitigation case study; embargo broken with public PoC, no upstream patch yet.

noted.product: NVIDIA GeForce NOW Armenia (GFN.am) regional partner
noted.summary: Third-party partner breach exposing names/emails/phones/DOB/2FA-status of Armenian-region users; NVIDIA core infrastructure unaffected, regional/consumer scope only.
VulnCheck 7-CVE batch 2026-05-06/07; small-deployment CMS with media-upload RCE and XXE-via-import worth attention if deployed.
VulnCheck re-issued 2026-05-08; older OS command injection in DrayTek routers/VPN devices; verify against patched firmware levels.
Local file inclusion via /api/v1/report/summary/{type} API endpoint; small-deployment mail/help-desk vendor, verify presence in fleet.
Multiple unauthenticated NEF + SMF API exposures; primarily research/lab software with limited production deployment, telecom/lab tagging only.
RCE via markdown links in Windows Notepad <11.2510; multiple PoC repos surfaced; out of scope (desktop-only client) but noted for IR awareness.
Auth bypass via patient-social-login REST endpoint; overlaps with prior 04-30 KiviCare batch coverage; PoC repo update only.
Heap buffer overflow in spell-file loading disclosed 2026-05-07 on oss-security; local file-handling vector, not internet-facing.
Defender-evasion process-termination technique via vulnerable driver; out of scope (LPE / EDR-bypass only).
